issuing_authority: Municipal Corporation / Town Panchayat (Registrar of Births and Deaths)
applicable_when: A person has died and the death needs to be officially registered

documents_required.name: Aadhaar card of the informant (person reporting)
Proof of address of the deceased
documents_required.where_to_get: Ration card / electricity bill / rental agreement

common_rejection_reasons: Death reported after 21 days (late registration needs magistrate order)
Hospital certificate not attested
Address mismatch between Aadhaar and ration card
legal_basis: Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 (Section 12, 13)

applicable_when: To establish legal heirs of a deceased person for pension transfer, bank account claims, and property mutation

documents_required.name: Aadhaar card of all legal heirs
Self-declaration affidavit on Rs.20 stamp paper
Passport-size photos of all legal heirs (2 each)
Community certificate of the deceased (if applicable)

common_rejection_reasons: Missing affidavit on stamp paper
Witness signatures incomplete or not matching Aadhaar
Death certificate not original or not attested
Ration card not updated to show all family members
Spelling mismatch between Aadhaar and ration card names
legal_basis: Tamil Nadu Legal Heir Certificate Rules, 1966; Tamil Nadu District Revenue Officers Manual

applicable_when: To claim movable assets (bank deposits above Rs.1 lakh, shares, mutual funds, fixed deposits) of the deceased when there is no will

documents_required.name: List of all movable assets with approximate values
Bank account statements / passbooks of the deceased
Aadhaar and address proof of the petitioner
Court fee stamp (ad valorem — 3% of asset value)

common_rejection_reasons: Incomplete list of assets
Missing court fee stamps
Other legal heirs not made party to the petition
Objection raised by another legal heir
legal_basis: Indian Succession Act, 1925 (Sections 370-390)

name_en: Pension Transfer to Widow / Legal Heir
applicable_when: The deceased was receiving a government pension and the spouse or dependent family member is entitled to family pension

documents_required.name: Pension Payment Order (PPO) of the deceased
Bank passbook of the claimant (for pension credit)
Two passport-size photos of the claimant

common_rejection_reasons: PPO number not matching records
Legal heir certificate not covering the claimant
Bank account not in the name of the claimant
Form 14 not countersigned by the last employer
legal_basis: CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021; Tamil Nadu Pension Rules

name_en: Bank KYC Update / Account Transfer or Closure
applicable_when: The deceased held bank accounts that need to be transferred to legal heirs or closed

documents_required.name: Legal Heir Certificate or Succession Certificate
Aadhaar and PAN of all claimants
Bank passbook / account statement of the deceased
Indemnity bond (for claims without succession certificate)
Letter of administration (if amount > Rs.1 lakh and no will)

common_rejection_reasons: Legal heir certificate not listing all account holders
Joint account holder disputes
Nomination exists but claimant is different person
Locker contents need separate inventory process
legal_basis: Banking Regulation Act, 1949; RBI Master Circular on Customer Service (DBR.No.Leg.BC.21/09.07.006/2015-16)

applicable_when: The deceased owned immovable property (land or house) whose patta (ownership record) needs to be transferred to legal heirs

documents_required.name: Encumbrance Certificate (EC) for the last 15 years
Tax paid receipts for the property
No-objection from all legal heirs (if transferring to one)

common_rejection_reasons: Encumbrance certificate shows existing mortgage or lien
Property tax arrears not cleared
Dispute among legal heirs — NOC not provided
Survey number mismatch between patta and ground reality
Illegal construction or encroachment on the property
legal_basis: Tamil Nadu Survey and Boundaries Act, 1923; Tamil Nadu Land Reforms Act; Tamil Nadu Patta Transfer Rules

applicable_when: To deactivate the Aadhaar number of a deceased person to prevent identity misuse

documents_required.name: Aadhaar card of the applicant (family member)

common_rejection_reasons: Death certificate not uploaded in correct format
Aadhaar number not matching UIDAI records
legal_basis: Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016

issuing_authority: Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) / Booth Level Officer (BLO)
applicable_when: To remove the deceased person's name from the electoral roll

documents_required.name: Voter ID card of the deceased (if available)

common_rejection_reasons: Name not found in the electoral roll for the given constituency
Form 7 incomplete
legal_basis: Representation of the People Act, 1950 (Section 22); Registration of Electors Rules, 1960

issuing_authority: Taluk Supply Officer / District Supply Officer
applicable_when: To remove the deceased person's name from the family ration card and update the head of family if needed

documents_required.name: Aadhaar card of the new head of family
Application form for ration card modification

common_rejection_reasons: Original ration card not produced
New head of family Aadhaar not linked to ration card
legal_basis: Tamil Nadu Essential Commodities (Regulation of Distribution) Order; National Food Security Act, 2013

applicable_when: The deceased had a life insurance policy and the nominee or legal heir needs to claim the benefit

documents_required.name: Claim Form (Form 3783 for LIC / insurer-specific form)
Aadhaar and PAN of the nominee/claimant
Bank account details of the nominee (cancelled cheque)
FIR / post-mortem report (if death is not natural)
Hospital discharge summary (if death during treatment)
Legal Heir Certificate (if no nominee designated)

common_rejection_reasons: Policy lapsed due to non-payment of premiums
Claim within 2 years of policy (contestability period) triggers investigation
Nominee details mismatch
Cause of death excluded under policy terms
legal_basis: Insurance Act, 1938; IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders' Interests) Regulations, 2017

name_en: Income Tax Final Return for Deceased
applicable_when: Filing the final income tax return for the deceased for the period from April 1 to the date of death, and claiming any refund

documents_required.name: Form 26AS / AIS of the deceased (tax credit statement)
PAN card of the legal representative filing
Registration as legal representative on IT portal

common_rejection_reasons: Legal representative not registered on the IT portal
PAN of deceased not active or linked to wrong Aadhaar
TDS credits not matching Form 26AS
legal_basis: Income Tax Act, 1961 (Section 159 — Legal representative)

issuing_authority: Sub-Registrar (Registration Department) or Hindu Marriage Registrar
applicable_when: A couple has married and needs to officially register the marriage

documents_required.name: Marriage invitation card or wedding photos
Aadhaar cards of bride and groom
Two passport-size photos of the couple (joint and individual)
Two witnesses with Aadhaar and photos

common_rejection_reasons: Marriage not registered within 90 days (late fee applies)
Age proof shows bride is under 18 or groom under 21
Witnesses not present in person at the registrar office
Address mismatch between documents
legal_basis: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955; Tamil Nadu Registration of Marriages Act, 2009; Special Marriage Act, 1954

applicable_when: After marriage, the person (usually the bride) wants to update their name on Aadhaar

documents_required.name: Gazette notification of name change (if changing surname)

common_rejection_reasons: Marriage certificate not reflecting the new name
Biometric mismatch during verification
Supporting documents not matching
legal_basis: Aadhaar Act, 2016; Aadhaar (Enrolment and Update) Regulations, 2016

name_en: Name Change on PAN Card (After Marriage)
applicable_when: After marriage, the person wants to update their name on PAN card

documents_required.name: Updated Aadhaar card with new name (recommended)

common_rejection_reasons: Photo or signature not clear in the application
Documents not self-attested
Aadhaar name and requested PAN name mismatch
legal_basis: Income Tax Act, 1961 (Section 139A); Income Tax Rules, 1962 (Rule 114)

applicable_when: A widow below the poverty line or without adequate income wants to apply for the state widow pension scheme

documents_required.name: Marriage certificate or proof of marriage

common_rejection_reasons: Income exceeds the eligibility limit
Already receiving pension from another scheme
Age below 18 or above 60 (shifted to old age pension)
Bank account not linked to Aadhaar
legal_basis: Tamil Nadu Destitute Widow Pension Scheme (G.O.Ms.No.61, Social Welfare Department, 2012)

applicable_when: Existing widow pension recipients need to renew their pension annually with a life certificate

documents_required.name: Life certificate / Jeevan Praman
documents_required.where_to_get: Common Service Centre or online via jeevanpramaan.gov.in

documents_required.name: Bank passbook showing recent pension credits

common_rejection_reasons: Life certificate not submitted before November 30 deadline
Biometric mismatch in Jeevan Praman
Remarriage not reported
legal_basis: Tamil Nadu Destitute Widow Pension Scheme; Jeevan Pramaan Scheme (Government of India)

applicable_when: Widow pension application was rejected or pension payments have stopped without explanation

documents_required.name: Copy of the original pension application
Grievance petition addressed to the District Collector
Proof of previous pension payments (if pension stopped)

common_rejection_reasons: Grievance filed at wrong authority level
Original rejection reason not addressed in appeal
legal_basis: Tamil Nadu Right to Service Act, 2010; Administrative Tribunals Act, 1985

issuing_authority: Public Information Officer (PIO) of the concerned department
applicable_when: When a citizen wants information about the status of their application, reasons for delay, or any government action

documents_required.name: Application fee (Rs.10 by postal order / demand draft / court fee stamp)
Proof of BPL status (if claiming fee exemption)
Copy of the original application/complaint reference (for tracking)

common_rejection_reasons: Information sought is exempted under Section 8
RTI sent to wrong PIO (should be transferred but sometimes rejected)
Application fee not attached or insufficient
legal_basis: Right to Information Act, 2005 (Sections 6, 7, 8)

name_en: Tamil Nadu Right to Service Complaint
issuing_authority: Appellate Authority under TN RTS Act / District Collector
applicable_when: When a notified government service is not delivered within the stipulated time limit

documents_required.name: Copy of the original service application with date stamp
Acknowledgement receipt from the government office
Complaint petition stating the delay and service details

common_rejection_reasons: Service not covered under the notified services list
Complaint filed before stipulated time limit has elapsed
Wrong appellate authority
legal_basis: Tamil Nadu Right to Service Act, 2010 (Sections 3, 4, 5)

applicable_when: When a government official has demanded a bribe, caused undue delay through corruption, or misused their position

documents_required.name: Written complaint with full details of the incident
Copy of the application that was stalled / denied
Details of the public servant (name, designation, office)

common_rejection_reasons: Complaint is vague without specific allegations
Matter already sub-judice in court
Complaint against non-public servant
legal_basis: Tamil Nadu Lokayukta Act, 2018; Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
